blocks.text: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz kicked off a five-day tour of Asia on Monday, traveling to Singapore before his scheduled visits to Japan and South Korea. Merz is accompanied by an entourage of 30 senior businesspeople, including representatives of Germany’s industry, tech and defense companies, and energy suppliers. At the same time, Germany’s President Frank-Walter Steinmeier is visiting China. While the trips are not officially related, they both seem aimed at boosting Berlin’s economic and security relationships at a time of geopolitical instability, which threatens global supply chains.
